summary: Return the current UTC and operator-local datetimes.

output_schema.utc_timestamp: date-time | The current UTC datetime in ISO 8601 format.
output_schema.local_timestamp: date-time | The current datetime in the operator's preferred timezone.
output_schema.local_timezone: string | The operator's preferred IANA timezone name.

slash_command.name: now
slash_command.description: show the current datetime (UTC and operator-local)
